name: attend-slack-notifications
description: Cloudflare Worker that posts to Slack whenever someone new signs up for a Hack Club Attend event.

ATTEND_TOKEN.description: An Attend mobile token. In BetterAttend: Settings → Developer → Copy a new mobile token. The worker rotates it automatically.

SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Slack incoming webhook URL to post sign-ups to (https://api.slack.com/messaging/webhooks).

ADMIN_KEY.description: Optional. Any long random string; enables the /status, /poll, /test and /reset endpoints.

ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Optional. A separate Slack webhook for 'token expired' alerts. Defaults to SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL.

ATTEND_EVENT.description: Event slug or ID, as in attend.hackclub.com/admin/<slug>. Comma-separate several.

MESSAGE_TEMPLATE.description: Optional. The Slack message posted for each new sign-up. Leave blank for the default, `new signup :yay:` with `total signups: {count}` on a second line. Placeholders: `{name}`, `{first_name}`, `{last_name}`, `{mention}` (pings them if Attend knows their Slack ID), `{email}`, `{status}`, `{count}` (total sign-ups), `{event}`, `{event_url}`. Slack formatting works, e.g. `*bold*`. [All placeholders](https://github.com/ingoau/attend-slack-notifications#placeholders)

SUMMARY_TEMPLATE.description: Optional. Posted instead of one message per person when more than 5 people sign up between checks. Leave blank for the default, `new signups :yay: x{new_count}` with `total signups: {count}` on a second line. Placeholders: `{new_count}` (how many the summary covers), `{count}` (total sign-ups), `{event}`, `{event_url}`.

SLACK_PAYLOAD_TEMPLATE.description: Optional, advanced. A whole Slack message as JSON, e.g. [Block Kit](https://app.slack.com/block-kit-builder), for buttons or richer layouts. Every string in it can use the placeholders above, and `{text}` is the rendered message template. Leave blank to post plain text. [Example](https://github.com/ingoau/attend-slack-notifications#full-payloads-block-kit)
